name: Sant Lluís (Spain)
description: White field with a thin blue border set in from the edge, charged at the centre with a disc bearing the arms of Sant Lluís (fleurs-de-lis on blue above the bars of Aragon).
history: Municipal flag of Sant Lluís; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.
